operations.description: This API is used to batch add tags to or delete tags from a specified resource. TMS needs to use this API to manage tags of resources in batches. A resource can have a maximum of 10 tags.
This API is used to bind global EIPs to a connect gateway.
This API is used to create a connect gateway.
This API is used to create a global DC gateway that can be attached to an enterprise router.
This API is used by partners to create hosted connections for their users. The creator must have the partner qualification and have an operations connection.
This API is used to add a peer link between a global DC gateway and an enterprise router or another global DC gateway.

This API is used to add a tag to a resource. - A resource can have up to 10 tags. - This API is idempotent. - If a tag has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will be created and overwrite the existing one.

This API is used to create an IPv6 peer.Each virtual interface can have two peers: IPv4 and IPv6 peers. When a virtual interface is created, an IPv4 peer is created by default. After a virtual interface peer is created, you can query its settings by viewing the virtual interface details. This API is available only in regions that support IPv6. To use this API, contact customer service.
This API is used to create a connectivity detection task for a virtual interface peer to test the connectivity of the remote gateway.
This API is used to create a virtual gateway.
This API is used to create a virtual interface.
This API is used to delete a connect gateway.
This API is used to delete pay-per-use connections only. You can only unsubscribe them yearly/monthly connections.
This API is used to delete a global DC gateway.
This API is used by partners to delete hosted connections.
This API is used to delete a peer link between a global DC gateway and an enterprise router.

This API is used to delete a tag.When a tag is deleted, the tag character set is not verified. Before this API is called, the API URL must be encoded, and the service who is calling this API must decode the API URI. If the key to be deleted does not exist, 404 is returned. The key cannot be left blank or an empty string.

This API is used to delete a virtual interface. The virtual interface must contain at least one peer. The last peer cannot be deleted. This API is available only in regions that support IPv6. To use this API, contact customer service.
This API is used to delete a connectivity detection task if you no longer need it.
The API is used to delete a specified virtual gateway.
This API is used to delete a virtual interface.
This API is used to query the list of connect gateways.

This API is used to query all the Direct Connect locations in a region. The **marker** and **limit** parameters are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query all direct connections created by a tenant.
This API is used to query the route tables for a global DC gateway.

This API is used to query the global DC gateway list. Pagination query is recommended. The **marker** and **limit** parameters are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the global EIPs bound to a connect gateway.
This API is used to query hosted connections created by partners.
This API is used to query the peer link list. The **marker** and **limit** parameters are used for pagination query. The two parameters take effect only when they are used together.
This API is used to query the tags of a resource type in a specific project. TMS uses this API to list tags created by a tenant to facilitate tag creation and resource filtering on the console.
This API is used to query the switchover test record list. Only the records whose **operate_status** is **COMPLETE** are displayed.
This API is used to query resources such as virtual gateways and virtual interfaces by tag.
This API is used to query information about multiple connectivity detection tasks for a virtual interface peer, including the task ID, start time, end time, status, and packet loss rate.
This API is used to query virtual gateways.
This API is used to query all virtual interfaces of a tenant.
This API is used to query the details about a connect gateway.
This API is used to query details about a connection.
This API is used to query details about a Direct Connect location.
This API is used to query details about a global DC gateway.
This API is used to query a hosted connection of a partner.
This API is used to query details about a peer link of a global DC gateway.
This API is used to query the usage of resources, for example, how many connections and virtual interfaces have been created.
This API is used to query resource tags.
This API is used to query the details about a connectivity detection task of a virtual interface peer, including the task ID, start time, end time, status, and packet loss rate.
This API is used to query details about a specified virtual gateway.
This API is used to query details about a virtual interface.

This API is used to perform a virtual interface switchover test.If there are two connections, automatic switchover between the connections is required for connectivity testing. If a switchover is performed, the virtual interface in use is disabled, and traffic is interrupted.You can perform two operations on a virtual interface:- Run the **shutdown** command to disable the virtual interface.- Run the **undo_shutdown** command to enable the virtual interface.If **shutdown** is selected for the switchover test, the virtual interface is in the **ADMIN_SHUTDOWN** state, and no operations can be performed on the virtual interface. If **undo_shutdown** is selected for the switchover test, the virtual interface is in the **ACTIVE** state.
This API is used to unbind global EIPs from a connect gateway.
This API is used to update a connect gateway.
This API is used to update a connection, including updating its name and description.
This API is used to update extended parameters for reliability on a virtual interface, such as **min_rx_interval**, **min_tx_interval**, and **detect_multiplier**.
This API is used to modify the route tables for a global DC gateway.
This API is used to update a global DC gateway, for example, the name and description of a global DC gateway.
This API is used to update a hosted connection created by a partner.
This API is used to update a peer link between a global DC gateway and an enterprise router.

This API is used to update a virtual interface peer, for example, its remote subnet, name, and description. This API is available only in regions that support IPv6. To use this API, contact customer service.
This API is used to update a virtual gateway.
This API is used to update a virtual interface.
